decision_summary: Police chief announced on 2026-08-14 that the department will not renew its Flock Safety relationship and will stop using the 11 license plate cameras pending the 2027 Iowa legislative session.
notes: Non-renewal is explicit and terminal for the current contract; cameras to be removed. Framed as a pause pending 2027 legislation, so a future re-adoption is possible. Contract start 2023-07-26 comes from the ACLU-IA report (advocacy source, unverified tier); Perry News independently reports citywide deployment began July 2023. None of the 11 cameras had been vandalized. No cost or contract end date found in verified sources.
